title: Mexico's constitution constitutes a representative, democratic, secular, federal republic of free and sovereign states
summary: Mexico's constitution constitutes a representative, democratic, secular, federal republic of free and sovereign states.
body: The English text says the Mexican people constitute a representative, democratic, secular, federal republic, made up of free and sovereign states in their domestic regime, united in a federation. The source says: "Type of government envisioned , Separation of church and state Article 40 It is in the will of the Mexican people to constitute into a representative, democratic, secular, federal, Republic, made up by free and sovereign States in everything related to its domestic regime, but united in a federation established according to the principles of this fundamental law." Secular and federal are both in the sentence. Indigenous peoples are treated in a further provision of the same constitution.
